footer.tagline: Move things across borders. A peer-to-peer logistics marketplace connecting travelers with deliveries.

landing.join_network: Join the peer-to-peer logistics network. List your upcoming trip to help move items along your way, or post a delivery to get an item carried across borders.
landing.spare_capacity: Put your spare luggage capacity to use. Connect directly with people who need items moved along your route—whether by flight, train, bus, or road.
landing.post_listing_content: You're going somewhere? Post a Trip. You need something delivered to you? Post a Delivery. You want something bought and brought to you? Post a Purchase Request.
landing.someone_reaches_out_content: Someone sees the listing and contacts. Users read each other's profiles, check reviews and whether they are verified, and message each other to confirm the details. If both sides agree, the match is confirmed. After the deals are confirmed, the listing is closed.
landing.you_both_agree_content: Message each other, work out the details, and decide together whether to move forward. Nothing happens without both sides agreeing—it's always your choice.
landing.close_deal_content: The deal happens, you mark it as closed, and both sides leave a review. That review becomes part of each person's public track record on Peregri.
landing.reviews_public_content: Left by both sides after a handover. Visible on profiles, not tied to any complaint.
landing.reports_private_content: A complaint filed against a user, seen only by the Peregri team — never posted publicly.
landing.accountability_content: We don't run background checks or issue verification badges. What we give you is a track record and a way to speak up—the decision to move forward is always yours.
landing.nothing_is_automatic_content: A match just means someone reached out. You decide whether to actually agree to a deal—no one is ever obligated to accept.
landing.reviews_build_track_content: After every closed deal, both sides leave a public review. Read someone's history before you decide to work with them.
landing.reports_stay_private_content: If something goes wrong, you can file a report our team reviews privately. Repeat or serious reports can get an account banned.
landing.route_search_subtitle: Find couriers already going your way — across an ocean or across town.
landing.post_listing_content_v2: You're going somewhere? Post a Trip. You need something delivered to you? Post a Delivery. You want something bought and brought to you? Post a Purchase Request. Don't have time to post? Browse the listings and reach out to a matching Trip, Delivery or Purchase Request.
landing.both_sides_agree_content: Users read each other's profiles, check reviews and whether they are verified, and message each other to confirm the details. If both sides agree, the match is confirmed. After the deals are confirmed, the listing is closed.
landing.deal_happens_content: The traveler carries the item along their route. The requester receives it. The listing is automatically deleted and stored in the user's history.
landing.leave_review_content: Both sides leave a public review. Reviews are visible on the user's profile and help build trust for future deals. Verified users are more likely to get confirmed and build a stronger reputation over time.
landing.verified_identity_content: Users can verify their identity through with a legal ID. Verifications are handled anonimously and securely by humans. Verified users build stronger trust — unverified status is shown on profiles and listings so you always know who you're dealing with.
landing.verified_users_badge: Verified users show a badge on their profile and listings. Unverified status is clearly flagged — so you always know who you're dealing with before you confirm.
landing.illegal_activities_content: Scamming, ghosting, or attempting to ship illegal goods results in a permanent ban. Reports are reviewed by our team and serious or repeat offenders lose access for good.
landing.trust_stranger: BUILT SO YOU CAN TRUST A STRANGER.
landing.trust_stranger_content: People are more likely to trust a stranger when they know the stranger is verified. Peregri strongly recommends that all users verify their identity and stay alert for unverified users.
landing.reviews_public_record_desc: Left by both sides after every handover. Visible on profiles permanently.
landing.legal_goods_only_content: Peregri is strictly for lawful items. Anyone attempting to ship drugs, weapons, counterfeit goods, or any prohibited contraband is permanently banned on the spot and may be reported to the relevant authorities.
landing.reviews_build_reputation_content: After every closed deal, both sides leave a public review. A courier's track record is visible before you ever message them — honesty compounds over time.
landing.scams_get_banned_content: Ghosting after confirmation, fake listings, or demanding payment outside the platform are treated as fraud. Reports are reviewed privately by our team; serious or repeat offenders lose access for good.

verification.verified_message: Your identity has been verified. You can now confirm matches on Peregri.
verification.other_not_verified: The other party hasn't verified their identity yet. Both participants must be verified before confirming a match.
verification.ask_them_verify: Please ask them to complete identity verification and try again.
verification.protect_message: To protect everyone on Peregri, we strongly recommend verifying your identity. Here's exactly what happens with your documents:
verification.encrypted_photos: ~ Photos are sent over an encrypted connection directly to our team
verification.human_review: ~ A real person reviews them — no automated processing
verification.no_storage: ~ Documents are not stored in a database. No risk of data breaches.
verification.no_sharing: ~ We never share, use, or distribute your personal information. With the sole exception of cases required by law.
verification.recommend_other_verify: We also recommend asking the other party to verify their identity.
verification.id_document_label: ID DOCUMENT (passport, national ID, driver's licence)
verification.documents_sent: Your documents have been sent for review. You'll be able to confirm the match once approved — this usually takes a few hours. You can close this and come back later.

unverified_warning.identity_unknown: This person's real identity is unknown to Peregri.
unverified_warning.confirm_risk: Confirming arrangements with unverified users increases the risk of fraud, dangerous items, and no-shows.
unverified_warning.advise_against_confirm: Peregri strongly advises against confirming arrangements with unverified users.
unverified_warning.contact_risk: Contacting unverified users significantly increases the risk of fraud, dangerous items, or wasted time.
unverified_warning.recommend_verified_only: We strongly recommend only engaging with verified users.
